description.value:
Any spell the white mage knows that has a variable that increases by caster level which has a maximum, that maximum is increased by the equivalent of one additional caster level. Thus, a white mage with this talent heals a maximum of 1d6+6 hit points with cure, and deals a maximum of 11d4 holy damage with holy.

Asterisk talent: only one such talent's effect may be applied to an individual spell; decision made before casting.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - White Mage (Advanced Mage Talents)
